title: Equality from inner products
statement: Let $V$ be a real inner product space, and let $u,v\\in V$. If $\\langle w,u\\rangle=\\langle w,v\\rangle$ for every $w\\in V$, then $u=v$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a real inner product space
Their inner products with every $w\\in V$ are equal
